run_compute_scaling_factors: run compute_scaling_factors to fit ScaleFactor modules in a FairChem model using training batches
run_fit_cli: run the fit.py CLI module with --checkpoint and config args to compute scaling factors
review_compute_scaling_factors: review compute_scaling_factors function that fits ScaleFactor modules in computation order and saves to checkpoint
refactor_train_batch: refactor _train_batch helper to customize forward pass and loss computation during scaling factor fitting
summarize_prefilled_input: summarize _prefilled_input utility that uses readline to prefill terminal input prompts with default values
